provenance: Deterministic synthetic observations for testing. Not Paprika dashboard schema or production telemetry.

counter_reset.assertion: Evaluate the real rate-before-aggregation query. Do not use a hand-written difference as a complete Prometheus rate oracle.

gap_and_zero.assertion: Two zero observations and a missing interval remain visually and semantically distinct.

narrow_breach.assertion: Actual reduction keeps or explicitly exposes the threshold breach; semantic max remains 250 at every panel width.

mismatched_timestamps.assertion: Synchronize by time; timestamp 30 means a=3 and b=20, never the same array index.

stable_identity.assertion: Color and legend identity follow the entity across ordering/filtering, with explicit authored overrides preserved.

melbourne_dst.assertion: Maintain monotonic UTC chronology; local labels cross from 01:59 AEST to 03:00 AEDT on 2026-10-04.

partial_records.assertion: Show a bounded sample/limit, not a claim that there are exactly 100 events.
